funnel_analysis.primary_goal: Convert prospects into booked onboarding calls for partner program
secondary_goals: Segment by expertise and work preferences
Collect ZIP, email, and calendar commitment

audiences.name: Solopreneur
audiences.psychographics: Self-motivated, resourceful, looking for scalable income
audiences.evidence_from_funnel: Quiz 02: 'Your experience as a solopreneur makes you a strong fit'

audiences.name: Agency Owner
audiences.psychographics: Growth-oriented, B2B focused, seeking new revenue streams
audiences.evidence_from_funnel: Screen mentions 'Agency expertise aligns perfectly with what our partners need'

audiences.name: Sales Professional
audiences.demographics: Experienced B2B/B2C salespeople looking for side income
audiences.evidence_from_funnel: Quiz mentions 'seasoned sales experts dramatically boost lead conversions'

audiences.name: SMB Owner
audiences.demographics: Small business owners with local market knowledge
audiences.evidence_from_funnel: Quiz addresses 'Small-business experts like you consistently achieve exceptional results'

value_propositions.primary_promise: Turn 2-4 hours/week into $400-$1,000 recurring monthly income
value_propositions.unique_mechanism: Pre-qualified warm leads delivered in your local area

transformation.before: Unpredictable income, active prospecting required, no recurring revenue
transformation.after: Stable monthly income, inbound leads provided, recurring client revenue

supporting_elements: 89% of SMBs hire local implementation partners (CNBC authority)
192 leads available in target area (scarcity + localization)
evidence: Quiz 05: '📈 Stable growth - Devoting 4-8 hours weekly unlocks 4-8 new clients'
Quiz 03: '89% of SMBs hire local partners' (CNBC stat)

value_propositions.primary_promise: Get verified access to local business leads ready to buy SaaS
value_propositions.unique_mechanism: Partner program with geographic targeting and business type matching

transformation.before: Spending time on cold outreach, low conversion rates, generic leads
transformation.after: Receiving qualified leads matching expertise, higher conversion, localized relationships

supporting_elements: Business type qualification (Food & Beverage, Hospitality, etc.)
Timeline expectations (1st contract by specific date)
evidence: Quiz 15: 'Enter your ZIP code to see the leads currently waiting'
Quiz 08: 'What types of businesses do you have experience working with?'
Quiz 19: '192 leads in your area fit your params'

value_propositions.primary_promise: Work remotely with local clients on your schedule
value_propositions.unique_mechanism: Flexible partnership model with no minimum hours requirement

transformation.before: Rigid 9-5 schedule, location-bound work, all-or-nothing commitment
transformation.after: Choose your hours, work from anywhere, scale up or down as needed

evidence: Quiz 04: 'How many hours can you dedicate?'
Quiz 11-13: Remote preference, local client preference, inbound preference questions

what_they_get: Access to 192 qualified leads in their ZIP code area
primary_offer.pricing_model: Revenue share (implied - not explicit in quiz)
primary_offer.evidence: Quiz 20: 'Complete onboarding and get your leads' + feature bullets

urgency_elements.message: 192 leads in your area (implies limited supply)
Including 3 warm: [specific restaurant names and addresses]

risk_reversal.purpose: Reduce perceived risk through mass adoption

risk_reversal.element: CNBC statistic validation (89% of SMBs hire partners)
Specific timeline expectations (2 days onboarding, Jul 18 first contract)
risk_reversal.purpose: Set realistic expectations to prevent buyer's remorse

risk_reversal.element: 'We don't send spam' + 'We don't sell your data to 3rd parties'

messaging.tone_of_voice: Professional yet encouraging, data-driven with emotional appeals
messaging.writing_style: Direct address ('you', 'your'), emoji usage for warmth, specific numbers for credibility
emotional_journey: Confirmation → Excitement ('You're booked!', 'excited to get you on board')
